handoff: QA pass on 23d8f3c: AC1-AC9 observed with the dev build in throwaway repos (temp NORN_HOME_DIR, pty via expect). list/get --json byte-identical to released 0.10.0; set/unset --user/--repo, dotted keys, list replaced whole; terminal pick writes the chosen file, Esc/Ctrl-C cancelled (exit 3) with files unchanged; no TTY/--json/agent env -> usage error 'pass --user or --repo'; invalid value/unknown key refused with files sha-unchanged; padded inline comments kept on every set/unset path; one-line git diff for set and unset at the terminal. Full suite 1265 pass, typecheck green.

criteria.evidence: AC1.md: dev `config list --json` and `config get default_mode --json` (and markdown get) byte-identical to released 0.10.0 `norn config [--json]` / `norn config default_mode`; `config get` shows value + layer (repo); old form `norn config default_mode` → exit 2 unknown_command; bare `norn config` lists the verbs. config.test.ts 21/21 pass.

AC2.md: `config set default_mode auto --user` wrote `default_mode: auto` to $NORN_HOME_DIR/config.yaml (exit 0); in a repo without a repo file `config get default_mode` shows auto from user; `--repo` changed .agents/norn/config.yaml (one-line diff).

AC3.md: `agents.claude.model opus --repo` (agent seeded with built-in adapter/args), `limits.deadline 90m --repo`, `notifiers '[...]' --user` all exit 0 and shown by `config get` with source; a 2-item user notifiers list replaced whole by a 1-item one.

AC4.md (pty via expect, person env): prompt 'Write to user (~/.norn/config.yaml) or repo (.agents/norn/config.yaml)?'; Enter → user file written; Down+Enter → repo file written (one-line diff); Esc and Ctrl-C → refused `cancelled` exit 3, both files' sha unchanged; same pty from an agent-session env → usage error file_required.
AC5.md: no TTY (stdin /dev/null) → `Usage error (file_required)` exit 2, do_instead 'pass --user or --repo'; `--json` → CliError with the same do_instead, exit 2; `unset` likewise; no file changed.

AC6.md: `slots.max lots --repo` → refused invalid_value '/slots/max must be integer' exit 3; `nonsense.key`, `limits.bogus` → refused unknown_key exit 3; invalid enum → invalid_value exit 3; `shasum -c` of both files OK afterwards.

AC7.md: commented repo file with padded inline comments; set of a changed scalar (top-level and nested), a new top-level key, a new nested key → each a single +/- line, all comments and key order kept; replacing the notifiers list changes only that list's lines.

AC8.md: `unset default_mode --repo` → one-line removal, get shows user layer; `unset default_mode --user` → get shows built-in; unset again (absent) → 'nothing changed' exit 0, sha unchanged; --user --repo together → usage error exit 2; unknown key → refused exit 3; no flag without TTY → usage error (AC5.md).

AC9.md: throwaway git repo with commented config, commands at a terminal (pty, pick repo): set limits.retries → numstat 1/1; set new limits.deadline → 1/0; unset default_mode → 0/1; set then unset limits.stalled → clean git status.
